Our team works together to develop products that matter — from improving safety driving systems to supporting next-generation vehicle development through research, prototyping, testing, and analysis. This role owns the development and direction of software system tests, programming, and documentation. You will analyze customer data and technical trends to determine user demands and set target performance goals for future products. You will drive software and systems development — from research and design through implementation, testing, and evaluation — in conjunction with vehicle hardware development. You will assess software requirements to determine feasibility within time and cost constraints, and lead consultation with vehicle development engineers and engineering staff to evaluate interfacing, operational, and performance requirements of overall systems, mainly in cockpit.
cond_0278.responsibilities:
Develop internal software solutions for data analysis, data ingestion, or web applications using Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Service, or Microsoft Azure.
Drive back-end services across the [Company name masked] vehicle connected system.
Direct the use of both public and private cloud environments to ensure a robust and scalable infrastructure.
Construct and adapt data models to support analysis work.
Design unit and integration tests.
Write technical reports and deliver feedback to [Company name masked] counterparts through writings, emails, and presentations.
Own the maintenance of internal web applications.
Construct software tools and internal packages to scale data analysis work for other team members.
Lead, conduct, and evaluate the Proof of Concept (PoC) stage in developing [Product name masked]'s next generation infotainment system, cockpit system including meters, displays, buttons, etc.
Plan, propose solutions, execute testing of potential solutions, and evaluate testing data regarding how the interface between software and vehicle hardware can be improved for big data analysis purposes.
Collect data from prototype systems, clean and prepare the data, analyze it, and draw conclusions on testing results.
Lead collaboration with technical experts including product managers, UI/UX designers, marketing experts, and other business stakeholders.
cond_0278.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, software engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Knowledge and/or certification in AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Communication skills across cultural and language barriers.
1–2 Years of automotive engineering experience including internship. Proof of relevant work via internships or an active GitHub page in lieu of professional experience is accepted.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge and experience in big data analysis or statistical data processing.
Knowledge and experience in Python, C++, or Java.

cond_0332.intro:
We are looking for a Cloud Platform / Big Data Engineer to join our team.
This role owns the development and direction of software system tests, programming, and documentation. You will analyze customer data and technical trends to determine user demands and set target performance goals for future products. You will drive software and systems development — from research and design through implementation, testing, and evaluation — in conjunction with vehicle hardware development. You will assess software requirements to determine feasibility within time and cost constraints, and lead consultation with vehicle development engineers and engineering staff to evaluate interfacing, operational, and performance requirements of overall systems, mainly in cockpit.
cond_0332.responsibilities:
Develop internal software solutions for data analysis, data ingestion, or web applications using Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Service, or Microsoft Azure.
Drive back-end services across the [Company name masked] vehicle connected system.
Direct the use of both public and private cloud environments to ensure a robust and scalable infrastructure.
Construct and adapt data models to support analysis work.
Design unit and integration tests.
Write technical reports and deliver feedback to [Company name masked] counterparts through writings, emails, and presentations.
Own the maintenance of internal web applications.
Construct software tools and internal packages to scale data analysis work for other team members.
Lead, conduct, and evaluate the Proof of Concept (PoC) stage in developing [Product name masked]'s next generation infotainment system, cockpit system including meters, displays, buttons, etc.
Plan, propose solutions, execute testing of potential solutions, and evaluate testing data regarding how the interface between software and vehicle hardware can be improved for big data analysis purposes.
Collect data from prototype systems, clean and prepare the data, analyze it, and draw conclusions on testing results.
Lead collaboration with technical experts including product managers, UI/UX designers, marketing experts, and other business stakeholders.
cond_0332.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, software engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Knowledge and/or certification in AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Communication skills across cultural and language barriers.
1–2 Years of automotive engineering experience including internship. Proof of relevant work via internships or an active GitHub page in lieu of professional experience is accepted.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge and experience in big data analysis or statistical data processing.
Knowledge and experience in Python, C++, or Java.

In this role, you will work alongside engineers and cross-functional partners to support vehicle software and data systems. The work spans cloud infrastructure, data analysis, and software development, and is done in close coordination with colleagues across teams and locations. Together, the team researches, prototypes, tests, and analyzes systems to support next-generation vehicle development.
cond_0405.responsibilities:
Work with the team to develop internal software solutions for data analysis, data ingestion, or web applications using Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Service, or Microsoft Azure.
Help enable back-end services across the [Company name masked] vehicle connected system.
Coordinate with infrastructure partners to leverage both public and private cloud environments and ensure a robust and scalable setup.
Work alongside analysts to construct and adapt data models that support analysis work.
Collaborate on designing unit and integration tests.
Write technical reports and share feedback with counterparts in [Location masked] through written communications and presentations.
Support the maintenance of internal web applications together with the broader team.
Build software tools and internal packages to help other team members scale data analysis work.
Coordinate with stakeholders to plan, conduct, and evaluate the Proof of Concept (PoC) stage in developing the next generation infotainment and cockpit system, including meters, displays, buttons, etc.
Work with hardware and software engineers to propose, test, and evaluate solutions for improving the interface between software and vehicle hardware for big data analysis purposes.
Collect data from prototype systems, prepare and clean the data, and work with the team to analyze results and draw conclusions.
Collaborate with product managers, UI/UX designers, marketing experts, and other business stakeholders throughout the development process.
cond_0405.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, software engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Knowledge and/or certification in AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Communication skills across cultural and language barriers.
1–2 Years of automotive engineering experience, including internships. Proof of relevant work via internships or an active GitHub page in lieu of professional experience is accepted.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge and experience in big data analysis or statistical data processing.
Knowledge and experience in Python, C++, or Java.
cond_0405.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0405.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.

This role owns the development and direction of software system tests, programming, and documentation. You will analyze customer data and technical trends to determine user demands and set target performance goals for future products. You will drive software and systems development — from research and design through implementation, testing, and evaluation — in conjunction with vehicle hardware development. You will assess software requirements to determine feasibility within time and cost constraints, and lead consultation with vehicle development engineers and engineering staff to evaluate interfacing, operational, and performance requirements of overall systems, mainly in cockpit.
cond_0440.responsibilities:
Develop internal software solutions for data analysis, data ingestion, or web applications using Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Service, or Microsoft Azure.
Drive back-end services across the [Company name masked] vehicle connected system.
Direct the use of both public and private cloud environments to ensure a robust and scalable infrastructure.
Construct and adapt data models to support analysis work.
Design unit and integration tests.
Write technical reports and deliver feedback to [Company name masked] counterparts through writings, emails, and presentations.
Own the maintenance of internal web applications.
Construct software tools and internal packages to scale data analysis work for other team members.
Lead, conduct, and evaluate the Proof of Concept (PoC) stage in developing [Product name masked]'s next generation infotainment system, cockpit system including meters, displays, buttons, etc.
Plan, propose solutions, execute testing of potential solutions, and evaluate testing data regarding how the interface between software and vehicle hardware can be improved for big data analysis purposes.
Collect data from prototype systems, clean and prepare the data, analyze it, and draw conclusions on testing results.
Lead collaboration with technical experts including product managers, UI/UX designers, marketing experts, and other business stakeholders.
cond_0440.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, software engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Knowledge and/or certification in AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Communication skills across cultural and language barriers.
1–2 Years of automotive engineering experience including internship. Proof of relevant work via internships or an active GitHub page in lieu of professional experience is accepted.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge and experience in big data analysis or statistical data processing.
Knowledge and experience in Python, C++, or Java.
cond_0440.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

This role develops and directs software system tests, programming, and documentation. It involves analyzing customer data and technical trends to determine user demands and set target performance goals for future products, and coordinating testing with counterparts. The role develops, researches, designs, implements, tests, and evaluates software and systems, in conjunction with vehicle hardware development, to enable vehicle compute units to perform their applications. It analyzes software requirements to determine feasibility of design within time and cost constraints, and consults with other vehicle development engineers and engineering staff to evaluate interfacing, operational, and performance requirements of overall systems, mainly in cockpit. It also formulates and designs software systems, using scientific analysis to measure outcomes of designs.

Support back-end services across the [Company name masked] vehicle connected system.

Construct and adapt data models to support analysis work.
Design unit and integration tests.
Write technical reports and provide written feedback to counterparts in [Location masked] via emails and documentation.
Support the maintenance of internal web applications.
Build software tools and internal packages to scale data analysis work for other team members.
Plan, conduct, and evaluate the Proof of Concept (PoC) stage in developing the next generation infotainment system, cockpit system including meters, displays, buttons, etc.
Plan, propose solutions, test potential solutions, and evaluate testing data regarding how the interface between software and vehicle hardware can be improved for big data analysis purposes.
Collect data from prototype systems, clean and prepare the data, analyze it, and document conclusions on testing results.
Coordinate with technical experts including product managers, UI/UX designers, marketing experts, and other business stakeholders on specific deliverables.

Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, software engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Knowledge and/or certification in AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Communication skills across cultural and language barriers.

1–2 Years of automotive engineering experience, including internship.
Knowledge and experience in big data analysis or statistical data processing.
Knowledge and experience in Python, C++, or Java.

Do your personal interests relate to road trips, going outdoors, off-road driving, hands-on work on cars, or rally and racing? If your answer is yes, then this job is right for you!
[Company name masked] is an innovation partner of [Company name masked] in [Location masked], and our mission is to serve as a R&D hub of the [Company name masked] Group. We strive to create products that ignite the hearts of our customers in [Location masked] market. We lead and support [Company name masked]'s next generation vehicle development by researching, prototyping, testing, and analyzing.
Develops and directs software system tests, programming, and documentation. Analyzes [Location masked] customer data and technical trends to determine user demands and set target performance goals for future products, and coordinates testing with [Location masked] counterparts. Develops, research, designs, implements, tests, and evaluates software and systems, in conjunction with vehicle hardware development, to enable vehicle compute units to perform their applications. Analyzes software requirements to determine feasibility of design within time and cost constraints. Consults with other vehicle development engineers and engineering staff to evaluate interfacing, operational, and performance requirements of overall systems mainly in cockpit. Formulates and designs software systems, using scientific analysis to measure outcomes of designs. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of cloud infrastructure and big data systems.
cond_0580.responsibilities:
Develop internal software solutions for data analysis, data ingestion, or web applications using Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Service, or Microsoft Azure.
Enable back-end services across the [Company name masked] vehicle connected system.
Leverage both public and private cloud environments to ensure a robust and scalable infrastructure.
Construct and adapt data models to support analysis work.
Design unit and integration tests.
Write technical reports and give feedback to [Company name masked] in [Location masked] by writings, emails, and presentations.
Support the maintenance of internal web applications.
Construct software tools and internal packages to scale data analysis work for other team members.
Plan, conduct and evaluate the Proof of Concept (PoC) stage in developing [Company name masked]'s next generation infotainment system, cockpit system including meters, displays, buttons, etc.
Plan, propose solutions, test the potential solutions, and evaluate the testing data, regarding how interface between software and vehicle hardware can be improved for big data analysis purposes.
Collect data from prototype system, clean/prepare the data, analyze the data, and draw conclusions on the testing results.
Collaborate with other technical experts including product managers, UI/UX designers, marketing experts, and other business stakeholders.

Knowledge and/or certificate around AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, software engineering, or equivalent, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Communication skills across cultural and language barriers.

1-2 Years previous automotive engineering experience including internship.
Knowledge and experience of big data analysis or statistical data processing.
Knowledge and experience in Python, C++, or JAVA.
